note: Papua New Guinea's largest banks are BSP, Kina Bank and Westpac PNG. BSP's site lists no personal credit card (only its Classic Visa debit card and KunduCard among its personal cards), and Westpac PNG's card terms weren't reached. Kina Bank's fees and charges document (August 2025, the latest on its site), read in full for its credit cards: the Visa Classic and Visa Gold cost 50 and 100 kina a year and the same to join, bear 22% and 20% a year on purchases and the same on cash advances from the day of the advance, ask a minimum repayment of 5% of the outstanding balance or 20 kina, whichever is greater, give up to 45 and 55 interest-free days, and charge 10 kina for a past-due payment, 10 kina over the limit and 20 kina for a dishonoured payment. Both cards must be fully secured against a mortgage or a Kina Bank deposit, a condition the game doesn't check.
